import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
P="prov"
seqs=json.load(open(f"{P}/anoctamin_seqs.json")); a5=seqs["ANO5"]
orth=json.load(open(f"{P}/ANO5_orthologs_reviewed.json"))
mouse=[v for k,v in orth.items() if "Mus" in k][0]

# quick local alignment of N-terminal 130 aa, human vs mouse (simple NW, identity scoring)
def nw_simple(a,b,gap=-4):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); Mx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); T=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    Mx[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap; Mx[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap
    T[:,0]=1; T[0,:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=(Mx[i-1,j-1]+(2 if a[i-1]==b[j-1] else -1), Mx[i-1,j]+gap, Mx[i,j-1]+gap)
            k=int(np.argmax(c)); Mx[i,j]=c[k]; T[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; pairs=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if T[i,j]==0: pairs.append((i,j)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif T[i,j]==1: pairs.append((i,0)); i-=1
        else: pairs.append((0,j)); j-=1
    return pairs[::-1]
pr=nw_simple(a5[:130], mouse[:130])
ident={p:(a5[p-1]==mouse[q-1]) for p,q in pr if p and q}
w=9
cons=pd.Series({c: np.mean([ident.get(x,False) for x in range(c-w//2,c+w//2+1)]) for c in range(1+w//2,130-w//2)})

txt=open(f"{P}/ANO5_alphamissense.csv").read().replace("\r","")
L=txt.strip().split("\n")
am=pd.DataFrame([l.split(",") for l in L[1:]], columns=["variant","am","cls"])
am["pos"]=am.variant.str.extract(r"^[A-Z](\d+)[A-Z]$").astype(int); am["am"]=am.am.astype(float)
per=am.groupby("pos").am.mean()
plddt=pd.read_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_AF_plddt.csv").set_index("resi").plddt
mis=pd.read_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_all_missense.csv"); mis["hgvs"]=mis.wt+mis.pos.astype(str)+mis.mut
mis=mis.drop_duplicates("hgvs")
mis["path"]=mis.clinsig.fillna("").str.contains("Pathogenic") & ~mis.clinsig.fillna("").str.contains("Benign")
pos_path=sorted(mis[mis.path].pos.unique())
tm=pd.read_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_TM_projection.csv")
casite=[626,629,672,675,704,708]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,10.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(4,1, height_ratios=[1.05,1.0,1.0,1.0], hspace=0.62)

# Panel A: domain map
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1,0.42),913,0.16, fc="#d9d9d9", ec="none"))
for _,r in tm.iterrows():
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((r.ANO5_start,0.30),r.ANO5_end-r.ANO5_start,0.40, fc="#7f9fc4", ec="k", lw=.5))
    ax.text((r.ANO5_start+r.ANO5_end)/2, 0.50, r.TM.replace("TM",""), ha="center", va="center", fontsize=7)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((530,0.26),35,0.48, fc="none", ec="#c0392b", lw=2.2))
ax.text(547,0.84,"SCRD 530-564\nswapped for mouse ANO1 554-588\nin chimera ANO515 / 'ANO5-1-5'",
        ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7.5, color="#c0392b")
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1,0.30),65,0.40, fc="#f0c419", ec="k", lw=.5))
ax.text(33,0.12,"disordered tail 1-65", ha="center", fontsize=7.5)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((48,0.26),17,0.48, fc="none", ec="#1a7a3c", lw=2.2))
ax.text(90,0.90,"basic-hydrophobic motif 48-64 (KRFNLFLRRRLMFQK)", fontsize=7.5, color="#1a7a3c")
for p in pos_path:
    ax.plot([p,p],[0.74,0.82], color="#333333", lw=0.9)
ax.plot([],[],color="#333333",lw=0.9,label="pathogenic / likely pathogenic missense (n=51)")
for c in casite:
    ax.plot(c,0.22,marker="v",color="#8e44ad",ms=5)
ax.plot([],[],marker="v",color="#8e44ad",ls="none",label="Ca$^{2+}$-site residues N626 E629 E672 E675 E704 D708")
ax.set_xlim(-10,925); ax.set_ylim(0,1.05); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("ANO5 (Q75V66) residue"); ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="lower right", frameon=False)
ax.set_title("A  ANO5 architecture: what the scrambling-defective chimera replaces (35 aa) and what it keeps (878 aa)", fontsize=10, loc="left")

# Panel B: AlphaMissense + pLDDT over N-term
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
ax.plot(per.loc[1:130].index, per.loc[1:130].values, color="#c0392b", lw=1.4, label="mean AlphaMissense")
ax.axhspan(0,0.34, color="#eafaea", zorder=0)
ax2=ax.twinx(); ax2.plot(plddt.loc[1:130].index, plddt.loc[1:130].values, color="#2c6fb5", lw=1.2, ls="--", label="pLDDT")
ax2.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT", color="#2c6fb5", fontsize=8); ax2.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.axvspan(48,64, color="#1a7a3c", alpha=0.15)
for p,lab in [(57,"R57"),(58,"R58"),(54,"F54"),(61,"F61")]:
    ax.annotate(lab,(p,per.loc[p]),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(0,6),ha="center",fontsize=7.5,color="#1a7a3c")
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("mean AlphaMissense", color="#c0392b", fontsize=8); ax.set_ylim(0,1.05)
ax.set_title("B  A constrained island (48-64) inside an otherwise tolerant, disordered N-terminal tail", fontsize=10, loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="lower right", frameon=False)

# Panel C: human-mouse conservation
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
ax.plot(cons.index, cons.values*100, color="#333333", lw=1.4)
ax.axvspan(48,64, color="#1a7a3c", alpha=0.15)
ax.set_ylabel("% identity\n(human vs mouse, 9-aa window)", fontsize=8); ax.set_xlabel("ANO5 residue")
ax.set_ylim(-3,105)
ax.text(56,8,"48-64", ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#1a7a3c")
ax.set_title("C  The 48-64 motif is invariant human/mouse while the surrounding tail diverges", fontsize=10, loc="left")

# Panel D: pathogenic enrichment
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[3])
enr=pd.read_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_pathogenic_enrichment_by_region.csv")
extra=pd.DataFrame([dict(region="SCRD 530-564", span="530-564", aa=35,
                         missense=int(((mis.pos>=530)&(mis.pos<=564)).sum()),
                         pathogenic=int(mis[(mis.pos>=530)&(mis.pos<=564)].path.sum()),
                         pct_path=round(100*mis[(mis.pos>=530)&(mis.pos<=564)].path.sum()/((mis.pos>=530)&(mis.pos<=564)).sum(),2),
                         odds_ratio=np.nan, fisher_p="")])
e2=pd.concat([enr,extra])
cols=["#f0c419","#bbbbbb","#7f9fc4","#bbbbbb","#c0392b"]
ax.bar(range(len(e2)), e2.pct_path, color=cols, ec="k", lw=.5)
for i,(n,k) in enumerate(zip(e2.missense, e2.pathogenic)):
    ax.text(i, e2.pct_path.iloc[i]+0.2, f"{k}/{n}", ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(e2))); ax.set_xticklabels(e2.region, fontsize=8, rotation=12)
ax.set_ylabel("% of recorded missense that are\npathogenic / likely pathogenic", fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("D  Pathogenic missense density by region (ClinVar via EBI Proteins API)", fontsize=10, loc="left")
plt.show()
e2.to_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_region_summary.csv", index=False)
print(e2.to_string(index=False))
